faq: Will you get my products ranking first?
No one can promise that. We improve speed and structure, which supports ranking, but results depend on competition, product demand and how much good content you publish.
Can speed changes break my checkout?
They can if done carelessly. We exclude cart and checkout from risky caching, test an order after each change and roll back anything that causes trouble.
Which SEO plugin do you use?
Yoast, Rank Math or All in One SEO, usually whichever you already run. We avoid running two at once and tell you if switching would help.
We tidy titles and meta text in this service. Full product descriptions for many products are a separate job, which we can quote once we see your catalog.
